_doc: Signal masts and signal posts on the lap corridor, and the count at every junction OSM tags as signalled (PLAN 4b). signal_mast: a pole with an arm over the roadway (signal heads hang from it); signal_post: a short post or pedestal by the kerb carrying signal or pedestrian heads. Classes are the eye's, off the aerial. Heads, their number and their faces are not read. See SURVEY.md.
